story.title: How Bella the butterfly got her courage
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time their lived a butterfly called Bella which means BEAUTIFUL. But Bella is always afraid. Some insects call her " Timentes" means scared in Latin. Bella got very sad, she sat alone not talking to anyone not even her family. She said to herself: everyone is right, I am a timentes butterfly, I will never have courage.

One day, a new butterfly came. She just came out of her cocoon, everyone was so excited, then she flew and came next to Bella. The new butterfly said: hi, my name is Clara what is your name? Bella said: oh, um.... are you talking to me? Clara said: of course I am. Bella said: well........ my name i-is... i-s Bella. Suddenly a pink butterfly came and said:

hey, Clara why are you talking to Bella? She is a bad butterfly she is always scared. If you talk to her you will also become like her. Clara said: hey! Don't talk to Bella like that! Bella said: she is right Clara, you shouldn't talk to me. Clara said: wait, you to? The pink butterfly flew away without saying a word. Clara came to Bella and said: Bella

don't listen to that butterfly , you are great! And you know what, everyone gets afraid it is normal. Bella said: but I am afraid of everything I was even afraid to come out of my cucoon! Clara said: ok, it might be that you are afraid but at least look at your wings, they are so beautiful! Just, be happy and you will forget everything about your fear.

Bella said: a-alright, but why don't we go to a place where there is no one because if we stay here and talk everyone would disturb us. I know a perfect place said, Clara. Where? Asked Bella. You will see, just follow me. A-alright said, Bella. Both of them flew and flew for an hour. Bella got really tired, then Clara stopped flying and

sat on a Banyan tree. She said: Bella, why don't you sit here with me, thins is where I was born, far away from your home. Bella also sat with her and said: re-r-really? Yes, and do you know whenever the wind comes, the Banyan tree comes alive, and he can listen to our words and when the branches and leaves of the tree shake, we can understand

what the banyan tree is trying to say. And then suddenly the wind came and the leaves and branches shook the banyan tree became alive! The banyan tree was crying too! Clara said: Banyan tree why are you crying? The banyan tree said: soon, the humans are going to chop me down, and they will build houses and buildings over here.

Clara said; What? I am not giving up my home. What do you say about that Bella? Bella said: um..... uh... d-d-do you think it will be safe to f-f-f-fight with the humans? Clara said: I know it won't be safe, but this is my home! I have to save it! Why don't we go and ask the other insects to help us so that we can save the Banyan tree? Bella had no other choice

and helped Clara. So both of them were flying, to go and meet the other insects for help. On their way, they saw a little girl trying to catch them. Although the little girl was like a monster to Clara and Bella. She had a little goat too. Then Clara and Bella hid near the bushes. The little girl went away because she couldn't see the other insects as they

were hiding. So they quickly went and convinced all the insects to help the banyan tree. All of them agreed and went to guard the banyan tree. After a couple of days, the humans arrived. They had HUGE machines and axes to chop the tree down. The birds pecked on the men's heads and the butterflies gave nectar to the bees and with the nectar

the bees made honey and they threw it on the men's foot so that the men couldn't move. After hard work, the humans ran away and never chopped the banyan tree. After that Bella got a lot of courage and she never got scared again. The End Moral of the story: ﻿ ﻿ never be scared

Some insects call her " Timentes" means scared in Latin.
Bella got very sad, she sat alone not talking to anyone not even her family.
She said to herself: everyone is right, I am a timentes butterfly, I will never have courage.
One day, a new butterfly came.
She just came out of her cocoon, everyone was so excited, then she flew and came next to Bella.

Bella said: oh, um....
are you talking to me?

my name i-is...
i-s Bella. Suddenly a pink butterfly came and said:
hey, Clara why are you talking to Bella?

Don't talk to Bella like that!
Bella said: she is right Clara, you shouldn't talk to me.
Clara said: wait, you to?
The pink butterfly flew away without saying a word.
Clara came to Bella and said: Bella
don't listen to that butterfly , you are great!
And you know what, everyone gets afraid it is normal.
Bella said: but I am afraid of everything I was even afraid to come out of my cucoon!
Clara said: ok, it might be that you are afraid but at least look at your wings, they are so beautiful!
Just, be happy and you will forget everything about your fear.
Bella said: a-alright, but why don't we go to a place where there is no one because if we stay here and talk everyone would disturb us.
I know a perfect place said, Clara.
Where? Asked Bella.
You will see, just follow me.
A-alright said, Bella.
Both of them flew and flew for an hour.
Bella got really tired, then Clara stopped flying and
sat on a Banyan tree.
She said: Bella, why don't you sit here with me, thins is where I was born, far away from your home.
Bella also sat with her and said: re-r-really?
Yes, and do you know whenever the wind comes, the Banyan tree comes alive, and he can listen to our words and when the branches and leaves of the tree shake, we can understand
what the banyan tree is trying to say.
And then suddenly the wind came and the leaves and branches shook the banyan tree became alive!
The banyan tree was crying too!
Clara said: Banyan tree why are you crying?
The banyan tree said: soon, the humans are going to chop me down, and they will build houses and buildings over here.
Clara said; What?
I am not giving up my home.
What do you say about that Bella?
Bella said: um.....
uh... d-d-do you think it will be safe to f-f-f-fight with the humans?
Clara said: I know it won't be safe, but this is my home!
I have to save it!
Why don't we go and ask the other insects to help us so that we can save the Banyan tree?
Bella had no other choice
and helped Clara.
So both of them were flying, to go and meet the other insects for help.
On their way, they saw a little girl trying to catch them.
Although the little girl was like a monster to Clara and Bella.
She had a little goat too.
Then Clara and Bella hid near the bushes.
The little girl went away because she couldn't see the other insects as they
were hiding. So they quickly went and convinced all the insects to help the banyan tree.
All of them agreed and went to guard the banyan tree.
After a couple of days, the humans arrived.
They had HUGE machines and axes to chop the tree down.
The birds pecked on the men's heads and the butterflies gave nectar to the bees and with the nectar
the bees made honey and they threw it on the men's foot so that the men couldn't move.
After hard work, the humans ran away and never chopped the banyan tree.
After that Bella got a lot of courage and she never got scared again.
The End Moral of the story: ﻿ ﻿ never be scared
